name: 60416 · Coal City, IL
findings: ZIP 60416 (Coal City) has 35 nonprofit organizations. 12 of them (34%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is public events, listed by 11 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (25% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 60416 (Coal City) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
33% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: More organizations list volunteering
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 60416 (Coal City) list volunteering on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 2.4 times the typical level).
